WITH demand AS (
    SELECT product_id, GROUP_CONCAT(id || ':' || qty ORDER BY id) AS order_lines,
           SUM(qty) AS ordered_qty, MIN(qty) AS smallest_line
    FROM main.orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT d.product_id, d.order_lines, d.ordered_qty, d.smallest_line,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.qty > 0 AND p.id IS NOT NULL THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) AS available_qty,
       COUNT(i.id) AS inventory_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL AND i.qty <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpositive_stock_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.product_id <> i.product_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_purchases,
       MIN(p.purchased) AS first_purchase,
       MAX(p.purchased) AS last_purchase,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND (DATE(p.purchased) IS NULL OR DATE(p.purchased) <> p.purchased) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_iso_purchase_dates
FROM demand AS d
LEFT JOIN main.inventory AS i
    ON i.product_id = d.product_id
    AND i.location_id IN (SELECT id FROM main.locations WHERE warehouse = 1)
LEFT JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
GROUP BY d.product_id
ORDER BY d.product_id

WITH order_demand AS (
    SELECT ol.id AS order_line_id,
           ol.product_id,
           ol.qty,
           SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.product_id
               ORDER BY ol.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS demand_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
),
warehouse_stock AS (
    SELECT i.product_id,
           l.aisle,
           l.position,
           i.qty,
           SUM(i.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY i.product_id
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS stock_end
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.locations AS l ON l.id = i.location_id
    JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
      AND i.qty > 0
      AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_demand)
)
SELECT d.order_line_id,
       d.product_id,
       s.aisle,
       s.position,
       SUM(
           MIN(d.demand_end, s.stock_end)
           - MAX(d.demand_end - d.qty, s.stock_end - s.qty)
       ) AS pick_qty
FROM order_demand AS d
JOIN warehouse_stock AS s
    ON s.product_id = d.product_id
   AND s.stock_end - s.qty < d.demand_end
   AND d.demand_end - d.qty < s.stock_end
WHERE d.qty > 0
GROUP BY d.order_line_id, d.product_id, s.aisle, s.position
ORDER BY d.order_line_id, MIN(s.stock_end)
LIMIT 1000
